name: Ultra Addons for WPForms
author: Themefic

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/ultra-addons-for-wpforms, or install directly from the WordPress Plugins screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to WPForms → Ultra Addons in your dashboard.
  4. Enable the addons you need and start building.
  5. Check our documentation for setup guides.
sections.faq:
Do I need WPForms installed?

Yes. WPForms must be installed and activated for Ultra Addons to work.

Where can I find form entries?

Under WPForms → Ultra Addons → Entries in your WordPress dashboard.

Are all addons free?

Yes, every included addon is completely free to use.

Will this affect my existing forms?

No. Ultra Addons works alongside WPForms without altering your existing forms or settings.

Can I export entries?

Yes. The Database addon allows you to export submissions anytime as a CSV.

Do you have a pro version planned?

Yes! We’re working on Pro addons that will include integrations like Google Sheets, PayPal, Stripe, and more.

How can I get support?

You can contact us through our Support Portal for help or feature requests.

sections.description:
7+ Essential Addons for WPForms – Advanced Phone, Database, File Upload, Multi-Step, Website URL, Repeater Mailchimp & more Coming Soon!

Extend Your WPForms with Free and Essential Addons for WordPress

👉 Official Demo: Visit Website
👉 Get Support: Submit a Ticket
👉 Documentation: View Docs
👉 Plugin Roadmap View Roadmap
👉 Join Our Facebook Community
👉 Join Our Community

Ultra Addons for WPForms is a growing collection of smart, high-performance addons that extend the power of WPForms.
It’s built to make form building easier, faster, and more powerful — with no coding required.

From saving entries to your database, enabling file uploads, or creating multi-step forms — these addons give you everything you need to build professional-grade forms that look great and perform even better.

FREE ADDONS INCLUDED

  • Advanced Phone Field
  • Database Addon
  • File Upload Field
  • Multistep Form Addon
  • Mailchimp Integration
  • Repeater Field
  • Website URL Field

Advanced Phone Field

Collect accurate phone numbers from users worldwide with a smart country selector, flags, and automatic number formatting.
Perfect for collecting customer details, leads, or support requests — ensuring clean and consistent data entry.

Database Addon

Save every WPForms submission directly to your WordPress database.
View, search, and export entries as CSV anytime — all within your dashboard.
Ideal for teams that want reliable, centralized data storage without third-party services.

File Upload Field

Allow users to upload images, resumes, or documents directly through your forms.
Includes built-in file validation, size limits, and secure storage.
Great for job applications, quote requests, and support forms.

Multistep Form Addon

Break long forms into smaller, more user-friendly steps with titles and progress indicators.
Improves user engagement and completion rates — perfect for surveys, registrations, or multi-section applications.

Mailchimp Integration

Connect WPForms directly with your Mailchimp account to automatically sync form submissions to your lists.
Add tags, trigger automations, and grow your email audience effortlessly.

Repeater Field

Enable users to dynamically add or remove repeating field groups (like name, email, or file uploads) without reloading the page.
Ideal for group registrations, orders, or team-based forms.

Website URL Field

Add a clean, dedicated URL input field that automatically validates website links to prevent invalid or mistyped entries.
Perfect for business forms, partner applications, or portfolio submissions.

BUILT TO EXTEND WPFORMS, NOT REPLACE IT

Ultra Addons for WPForms works directly inside the existing WPForms interface — no extra configuration needed.
Simply install, activate, and start enabling new addons instantly.

No learning curve. No code. Just more power for your forms.

MORE FEATURES COMING SOON

We’re already building powerful new addons and integrations, including:

  • Google Sheets Integration
  • Conditional Logic Enhancements
  • Advanced Redirection Options
  • Payment Gateways
  • Automation Workflows

Stay tuned for future releases!

WHY YOU’LL LOVE ULTRA ADDONS FOR WPFORMS

  • 100% Free and beginner-friendly
  • Fully compatible with WPForms (Free & Pro)
  • Lightweight, fast, and performance-optimized
  • Drag-and-drop simplicity — no coding needed
  • Regular updates and new addons coming soon

START BUILDING SMARTER FORMS TODAY

If you’re already using WPForms, now’s the perfect time to enhance it with Ultra Addons for WPForms.
Install it today and unlock a smarter, faster, and more flexible form experience.

👉 Download the plugin and start exploring all free addons now.

Ultra Addons for WPForms — Extend. Simplify. Empower.
Build better forms, collect better data, and take WPForms beyond its limits.
